adopted: D43: selectable growth points coexist with use-restricted materials and cards
limits: Reward bundles, source assignments, amounts and recipes are provisional. D43 does not require both costs on every upgrade.
Point-only sample upgrades reuse AE values solely for wiring checks. Permanent reduction and prices are not adopted.
Duplicate card unlocks are recorded as unresolved. No additional points, physical inventory or compensation is inferred.
Materials have separate counts; they cannot implicitly substitute for points or for another material.
Natural runs reuse AE-Z seeds 0 and 1 without selecting successful endings. The adapter preserves previously supplied knowledge; AF does not add an observation UI or re-test D42.
